headlines.summary: The bank has advised customers to use UPI Lite and ATM services during this period.

headlines.headline: Infosys Q2 results: Revenue and net profit likely to remain flat; key focus on FY27 guidance and deal wins
headlines.summary: Infosys will announce its Q2FY27 results on Friday, October 23, after market hours. Experts expect low single-digit sequential growth in revenue and net profit, a slight dip in margins and a possible cut in FY27 guidance. The stock goes into the results with the strongest chart among IT majors this season.

headlines.headline: SENSEX drops over 1,250 points from day's high, NIFTY50 tests 22,400 as crude tops $114

headlines.headline: Cyient, TCS, Infosys: IT stocks power ahead as NIFTY IT surges 16% in a month — what’s driving the rally?
headlines.summary: The NIFTY IT index has rallied around 16% in October so far, supported by better-than-expected September-quarter earnings from major IT companies, healthy deal wins and improving management commentary.

headlines.summary: Tata Consultancy Services, Infosys, Reliance Industries, Bharti Airtel, Larsen & Toubro and HCL Technologies were top movers in the SENSEX.

headlines.headline: Infosys, Wipro: IT stocks steal the show as Nifty IT jumps 3% against market trend; what’s driving the rally?
